rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a companion, especially a child, to play with.

example.english: When I was little, Ming was my closest playmate.
example.traditional: 我細個嗰陣，阿明係我最要好嘅玩伴。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 aa3 ming4 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 jiu3 hou2 ge3 waan2 bun6

rows.note: Use this for the lover sense rather than a companion a person merely plays with.

example.english: She’s my playmate—the woman I’m in love with.
example.traditional: 佢係我情人，唔係普通朋友。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 cing4 jan4 m4 hai6 pou2 tung1 pang4 jau5
